Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter

Record Class ScanReport

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter.ScanReport
Record Components:
detections - infected / unreadable files (never null)
scannedFiles - files ClamAV scanned (from the summary)
scannedDirectories - directories ClamAV walked (from the summary)
infectedFiles - infected-file count (from the summary)
totalErrors - error count (summary "Total errors" plus error lines)
knownViruses - signature count the engine loaded (from the summary)
engineVersion - engine version reported in the summary, else empty
timeSummary - the summary "Time" value, else empty
sawSummary - whether a SCAN SUMMARY block was present
fileLinesSeen - per-file status lines seen (OK / FOUND / ERROR)
exitCode - the scanner process exit code
errorMessage - the first general error line, else empty
public record ScanReport(List<Detection> detections, int scannedFiles, int scannedDirectories, int infectedFiles, int totalErrors, long knownViruses, String engineVersion, String timeSummary, boolean sawSummary, int fileLinesSeen, int exitCode, String errorMessage) extends Record
The parsed result of one ClamAV scan, produced by AntivirusBackend.parseScanOutput(java.util.List<java.lang.String>, int) from the scanner's combined stdout/stderr and its exit code. It carries the per-file Detections, the SCAN SUMMARY counters and enough signal for the UI to tell the three outcomes apart: threats found, a clean scan, or a scan that never really ran (for example clamdscan with the clamd daemon stopped, which prints a summary full of errors and no file lines).
